meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键进入小说写作工作台，集中管理拆文库与文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在写网络小说并希望一个入口集中管理拆文和文稿
copy.tagline_en: Open a fiction writing dashboard to manage clips and drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want a single hub for materials and manuscripts.

howto.what: 这是一个网文工具箱的路由入口。Claude 会分析请求意图，把写作、拆文、扫榜等模糊需求分发给对应子技能，并负责项目状态检查、多书切换和版本更新检查后再告知用户。
howto.when: 当用户说出 /story、/网文 等触发词，或说「我想写小说」等请求，意图不明确时也会触发。

say.note: 会先问是长篇还是短篇，再路由到对应写作技能。
对比当前版本和最新版，告知结果并询问是否升级。
列出所有书目，选择后切换当前活跃项目。

howto.what_en: This is the router entry for the web-novel toolbox. Claude analyzes request intent and routes vague needs (writing, breakdown, ranking scan, etc.) to the appropriate sub-skill. It also checks project state, switches active books, and reports version-update status.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says /story, /网文, “I want to write a novel”, etc., or when intent is unclear and needs routing.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel.
say_en.note: Asks if it's long-form or short-form, then routes to the matching writing skill.
Compares versions, reports, and asks to upgrade.
Lists all books, then switches the active project after selection.
